# Impact: kick and snare together on the drum synth, through a plate reverb.
# Run:  soundcraft-cli script impact-drums.txt --bounce impact.wav --start 0 --end 1.2
# Then: soundcraft-cli convert impact.wav impact16.wav --bit-depth 16 --normalize   (the raw bounce peaks near -11 dBFS)
session.new {"name":"impact","sample_rate":44100,"bit_depth":16}
track.new {"kind":"instrument","name":"Drums","instrument":"drum_synth","format":"stereo"}
mix.instrument {"track":1,"plugin":"drum_synth","params":{"kick_decay":300,"kick_tune":-4,"snare_snappy":80,"snare_decay":350}}
mix.insert {"track":1,"slot":"a","plugin":"plate_reverb"}
midi.new_clip {"track":1}
# General MIDI drum notes: 36 kick, 38 snare (both produced sound here). Other drum_synth voices: hats, toms, cymbal.
midi.note_add {"clip":2,"pitch":36,"start_ticks":0,"length_ticks":120,"velocity":127}
midi.note_add {"clip":2,"pitch":38,"start_ticks":0,"length_ticks":120,"velocity":120}
